messages:
chris.pm: Heads up — we need to finalize entitlement granularity for new HW partner (EdgeAtlas). Proposed: hourly granularity with optional per-minute for burst customers. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

emma.partnerships: Hourly makes billing simpler for marketplace, but partner prefers per-minute to match device telemetry. Can we support both and map per-minute to hourly rollups?

raj.engineering: We can accept per-minute payloads and aggregate to hourly. Need to decide rounding: floor to minute, then sum; what to do with partial minutes at window edges? Also impacts latency on ingestion.

lina.sre: SLOs: if per-minute, ingestion window must be within 5m; otherwise mark as 'late' and route to backfill. We'll need test harness to simulate late arrivals.

metering-bot: SYSTEM: Schema v2 accepted fields: partner_id, usage_unit, usage_value, timestamp_iso8601, seqno

chris.pm: Good. Draft policy: default public marketplace SKU: hourly aggregation. If partner sends per-minute, we'll accept seqno'd events and store raw for 30 days, rollups hourly for billing. Late window: 24h for credits/backfill. Can everyone live with that?

emma.partnerships: 24h backfill acceptable. Partner asks about entitlements mapping when device offline (zero reports). Proposal: partner sends zero-usage heartbeat every hour; if missing, we infer last-known state and set zero only after 3 consecutive missing heartbeats.

raj.engineering: Implementation detail: we need a flag in payload 'heartbeat=true' and a small TTL. Also log an event for missing heartbeats to partner dashboard.

lina.sre: For test harness: create a sandbox endpoint and a replay tool to upload shuffled per-minute payloads. We should validate idempotency by re-sending same seqno.

chris.pm: Action items: 1) Engineering builds sandbox + replay tool (raj). 2) Partnerships to share sample device telemetry and expected mapping (emma). 3) SRE to define late-window alerting and dashboard (lina). 4) PM to update contract language for 24h backfill (chris).

raj.engineering: I'll spin up a basic harness by EOD Friday. Will wire in idempotency and a small CLI: example payload: ```json
{"partner_id":"edgeatlas","usage_unit":"device_minute","usage_value":1,"timestamp":"2026-03-20T15:22:00Z","seqno":"abc123","heartbeat":false}
```

emma.partnerships: I'll get sample streams from partner tomorrow. Also loop in legal for contract phrasing.

lina.sre: Can we add a synthetic load test at 10k events/s to the harness? Need to ensure autoscaling kicks in.

chris.pm: Yes please. raj, please include simple dashboard widgets for per-minute dropouts, aggregation lag percentiles.

raj.engineering: Will do. Expect a PR with docs + harness link.

emma.partnerships: One more: partner wants us to expose an 'entitlement-mapping' endpoint so they can validate mapping before go-live.

chris.pm: Agree — add to sandbox API. We'll schedule a partner runbook session next week. Thanks all :rocket:
